assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one transparent foreground terrain sprite for a ToME tabletop dungeon board, stone STAIRS UP, square canvas.
Primary request: a single short freestanding flight of five broad worn limestone steps visibly RISING ABOVE ground, from the bottom/front toward the top/back, ending at an elevated small landing. The two stepped side faces show the height positively and unambiguously. This is a compact architectural miniature, not a character or a UI icon.
Reference role: the previously inspected Kor'Pul floor and production sheet are STYLE/MATERIAL REFERENCES only. Match their muted warm grey-beige weathered stone, chipped pale edges, chunky readable construction and restrained painterly tabletop finish. Do not reproduce their floor, layout or labels.
View: steep overhead orthographic game view, looking down from south, with just enough south/east face visible to read the raised stair height. Stair direction straight north, no diagonal diamond/isometric base. Centered, entire architectural object within the central 82 percent of a square canvas, no part crosses cell edges.
Design for 48px: five large clear treads, strong alternating tread/riser value, broad rising stepped silhouette, small crisp upper-left highlights and dark lower-right contact shadow. Subdued greige stone; bright raised landing, no black recessed well.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent RGBA background everywhere outside the stairs and a very restrained local contact shadow. NO floor plate or environment; the game supplies the continuous floor underneath. Native alpha is required.
Constraints: one object only, no text, no numbers, no arrow, no border, no round token base, no selection or faction ring, no large red/green/blue areas, no characters, no ornament or rubble clutter, no glow, no frame. No arch or doorway: this sprite is only the raised stone staircase. Make it usable as a clean compositable foreground.
assets.source_hint:

If you need to use a generated image at another path, copy it and leave the original in place unless the user explicitly asks you to delete it.
The generated image is already displayed to the user. There is no need to render it in the final response as a Markdown image or file link.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one transparent foreground terrain sprite for a ToME tabletop dungeon board, stone STAIRS DOWN, square canvas.
Primary request: a single recessed rectangular stairwell CUT DOWN INTO the ground. A low square stone rim surrounds a large dark rectangular opening; four wide stone steps descend away from the lower/front edge toward the black upper/back depths. Steps become smaller and darker deeper in the opening. Strong visible dark inner side walls show NEGATIVE depth, with the darkest void occupying the far upper third. No elevated freestanding flight.
Reference role: the previously inspected Kor'Pul floor, production sheet and UP sprite are STYLE/MATERIAL REFERENCES only. Match muted warm grey-beige weathered limestone, chipped pale edges, chunky readable construction and restrained painterly tabletop finish.
View: steep overhead orthographic game view from south; the rectangular opening axis straight north, edges nearly axis aligned, no diagonal diamond/isometric base. Centered, entire rim and opening within central 82 percent of square canvas. The low rim is thin enough to read as cut into the floor.
Design for 48px: broad near-black hollow is primary shape; short run of four broad descending treads in lower half, enclosing stone rim, bright near threshold. Distinguishable by silhouette and dark recess from the bright raised UP flight. Interior darkness is OPAQUE, not transparent, so the floor cannot show through the pit.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent RGBA outside the stone rim only. NO full-cell floor, no terrain surrounding the rim: game supplies continuous floor underneath. Native alpha is required.
Lighting: upper-left neutral warm light, inner shadows deep charcoal. Restrained greige palette.
Constraints: one object only, no text, no numbers, no arrow, no UI border, no round token base, no selection or faction ring, no large red/green/blue areas, no characters, no ornament or rubble clutter, no glow. No arch or doorway. Entire piece contained inside one square cell.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one transparent foreground terrain sprite for a ToME tabletop dungeon board, stone WORLD EXIT leading up to the surface, square canvas.
Primary request: a compact freestanding thick stone ARCHWAY with rounded arched top, framing a bright daylight passage to the surface, with three short worn rising approach steps. A very small but clearly shaped folded parchment MAP EMBLEM is mounted on the arch keystone: three zigzag folded panels, simple engraved winding route with no letters. The arch and open daylight center are the primary shape; map is secondary. A tiny restrained vista of pale sky and distant muted earth-green hills appears ONLY inside the arch opening, indicating outside world. No magical portal.
Reference role: previously inspected Kor'Pul floor/production sheet and stone stair sprites are STYLE/MATERIAL REFERENCES only. Match muted warm grey-beige weathered limestone, chunky chipped blocks, pale edge highlights and restrained painterly tabletop miniature finish.
View: steep overhead orthographic game view from south, enough south-facing arch opening visible to identify it. Straight north alignment, no rotated diamond base. Entire compact object centered within central 82 percent of square canvas, clear margins on all four sides. Arch crown well below upper edge.
Design for 48px: unmistakable rounded stone doorway silhouette around pale daylight center, short staircase at bottom, map-shaped badge at crown. Broader stone blocks and simple forms, no fine filigree. This must not resemble the rectangular dark DOWN well or the bare UP steps.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent RGBA background outside the arch and short steps. Interior daylight window is opaque; outside object remains transparent. No full-cell floor plate, no surrounding landscape: game supplies continuous floor underneath. Native alpha required.
Lighting: upper-left neutral warm light, pale daylight within opening, no external glow spill.
Constraints: one compact architectural object only, no text, no letters, no numbers, no directional arrow, no UI border, no round token base, no selection or faction rings, no large red/green/blue color fields, no characters, no rubble clutter, no torches. No floating icons: the small folded map emblem is physically attached to arch keystone. Entire artwork fits one cell.
